paigasus-core's `main` ruleset requires the `moon ci` status check with
`strict_required_status_checks_policy: true` (branch must contain latest main), plus
deletion/non-fast-forward protection. There is no required-review rule — `gh pr merge
--squash` works directly once checks are green and the branch is current.

**Why:** merging PRs in sequence invalidates the next PR's merge eligibility
(`mergeStateStatus: BLOCKED`, "base branch policy prohibits the merge") until its branch
contains the new main head.

**How to apply:** for dependabot merge trains, merge one PR, then wait — dependabot
auto-rebases its remaining PRs onto new main (check `headRefOid` changed) and `moon ci`
re-runs; merge when green. BUT dependabot stops rebasing a branch once anyone else pushes
to it — then use `PUT /repos/.../pulls/N/update-branch` (GitHub-signed merge of main into
the branch) and wait for the re-run. Its `expected_head_sha` must be the FULL 40-character SHA:
a short SHA returns HTTP 422 "expected head sha didn't match current head ref" (PR 329,
2026-09-27). The same call also works for your own feature PR right after `gh pr create`, and it
avoids a local rebase that would re-sign every commit. Watch main after each merge: push-to-main triggers
`CI`, `prebuild`, and sometimes `Dependency Graph`.

**`gh pr update-branch --rebase` is the right tool** (avoids a merge commit, so the commitlint
parity gate only ever sees dependabot's own commit) — **but it makes dependabot REGENERATE the
PR**, re-resolving deps to newest-available and blowing past the npm cooldown. See
[[pnpm-minimum-release-age]] for the resulting catch-22 and its fix.

A full 7-PR train (2026-08-05) took ~6 serial CI cycles at ~10-20 min each. The local
`.lefthook/pre-push/check-branch.sh` enforces `^feature/[a-z0-9._-]+$` (no Linear key
required; `main` and `dependabot/*` are exempt) and validates the CURRENT branch name — so to
push a fix onto a dependabot branch, rename the local branch to match it first.

Related: [[paigasus-commit-signing-1password]] (API-commit fallback when 1Password is locked),
[[dependabot-cargo-lockfile-truncation]] (never merge a cargo PR without checking its lock).

#!/bin/bash
# Merge each listed PR when GitHub reports it CLEAN. Print only state changes.
prs="$*"; declare -A last
while [ -n "$prs" ]; do
  next=""
  for n in $prs; do
    s=$(gh pr view "$n" --json state,mergeStateStatus,headRefOid \
        --jq '"\(.state) \(.mergeStateStatus) \(.headRefOid[0:8])"' 2>/dev/null || echo "ERR")
    case "$s" in
      MERGED*|CLOSED*) echo "PR $n is $s"; continue ;;
      *" CLEAN "*)
        if out=$(gh pr merge "$n" --squash 2>&1); then echo "MERGED PR $n ($s)"; continue
        else echo "merge FAILED for PR $n ($s): $out"; fi ;;
    esac
    [ "${last[$n]}" != "$s" ] && echo "PR $n: $s"
    last[$n]="$s"; next="$next $n"
  done
  prs="$next"
  [ -n "$prs" ] && sleep 60
done
echo "train done"

input.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Like merge-train.sh, but for PRs that we pushed fixes to: dependabot no longer
# rebases them, so call update-branch when a PR is BEHIND main.
prs="$*"; declare -A last updated
while [ -n "$prs" ]; do
  next=""
  for n in $prs; do
    s=$(gh pr view "$n" --json state,mergeStateStatus,headRefOid \
        --jq '"\(.state) \(.mergeStateStatus) \(.headRefOid)"' 2>/dev/null || echo "ERR")
    case "$s" in
      MERGED*|CLOSED*) echo "PR $n is $s"; continue ;;
      *" CLEAN "*)
        if out=$(gh pr merge "$n" --squash 2>&1); then echo "MERGED PR $n ($s)"; continue
        else echo "merge FAILED for PR $n ($s): $out"; fi ;;
      *" BEHIND "*)
        sha=${s##* }
        if [ "${updated[$n]}" != "$sha" ]; then
          if out=$(gh api -X PUT "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/$n/update-branch" -f expected_head_sha="$sha" 2>&1); then
            echo "update-branch PR $n from ${sha:0:8}"
          else echo "update-branch FAILED PR $n: $out"; fi
          updated[$n]="$sha"
        fi ;;
    esac
    [ "${last[$n]}" != "$s" ] && echo "PR $n: ${s% *} ${s##* }" | cut -c1-80
    last[$n]="$s"; next="$next $n"
  done
  prs="$next"
  [ -n "$prs" ] && sleep 60
done
echo "train done"
